description: SnapClip! - Performance friendly Minecraft Replay/Clipping mod, that allows you to view the replay without having to log off.

mods.name: SnapClip
mods.description: Clipping + instant replay. /clip <seconds> [name] exports the last seconds to a .iusclip; /clip play <name> replays it in-world (MODERN: chunk world + freecam + relocate + ghost equipment/health/totem); /replay rewinds the rolling 60s buffer (POV/FOLLOW/FREECAM); /record start/stop writes a long .iusclip directly. Shows your own player in clips and replays. Client-only.
